'''Pilia Tonth''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].

==Biography==
Pilia Tonth was a small, sturdy woman with short [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and a pixie nose. As the daughter of a member of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Tonth received an easy appointment with the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] based on nepotism rather than ability. For this reason, Tonth wanted promotion to a position which she believed was more worthy of someone of her ability.

==Personality and traits==
Tonth was a serious woman who enjoyed puzzles, but became annoyed when stumped. She saw herself as someone doing an important job rather than a reckless adventurer, but was willing to risk her ship and crew to get promotion out of the Survey Corps.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'' {{1st}}
